title: pr-498120-state-sanitizer-tf-module-gpu-pools-iam-consolidation
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: operator teams reported recurring tfstate drift between GPU nodepool leases and IAM attachments after upgrades; existing ad-hoc repair scripts were brittle. This PR introduces a reusable terraform module (tf-state-sanitizer) and small shim changes to existing gpu_pool and iam modules to canonicalize state, collapse duplicate grant entries, and add an idempotent dry-run migration path. The goal is to provide an automated, safe migration that can be run as part of Private installer upgrades or as a one-off reconciliation step with minimal downtime. What changed: 1) new modules/state-sanitizer: Go-based import helper and a thin terraform wrapper that computes a canonical lease index for each gpu subpool, detects duplicate role attachments, and emits an ordered import plan; 2) gpu_pool module: add optional lease_index output and stable import_id to avoid create/destroy churn; 3) iam module: normalize principal identifiers and replace repeated aws_iam_role_policy_attachment resources with a single consolidated resource guarded by lifecycle ignore_changes until migration completes; 4) upgrade hooks: installer chart post-upgrade job that can run the sanitizer in dry-run or apply mode with a built-in checkpoint so the operation is resumable; 5) test infra: acceptance tests under perf-canary and a mock VPC local runner for CI. Migration plan (short): run sanitizer in dry-run on a staging cluster, review the generated import plan, run with --apply for a rolling reconciliation, verify workloads by checking node labels/leases and IAM audit logs. Rollback: sanitizer writes a checkpoint file to object storage and creates a tfstate snapshot tag; uninstall path includes a rollback tool that replays the snapshot. Checklist: [x] module design doc attached, [x] unit tests for import helper, [x] acceptance tests in perf-canary, [x] upgrade hook added to installer helm chart, [x] Linear tickets created. Risks & mitigations: changes touch tfstate manipulation; we added a dry-run mode, snapshot/restore, and strict preflight checks (owner lock, minimal quorum) to reduce blast radius. Related: ENG-7321 (migration plan), SUP-1982 (customer-reported drift), design doc: /docs/tf-state-sanitizer.md. Merge outcome: merged via squash with branch protections and post-merge promotion to release candidate channel.
